title: Rename billingUrl to billingEndpoint in shared-contracts and all apps (core-shell, billing, reports)

summary: Renamed billingUrl -> billingEndpoint (same value) in libs/shared-contracts and its consumers core-shell, sub-route-billing, sub-route-reports in one mono PR (#1); CI and CD green. Assumptions: platformkit repo has no reference to the setting so needs no release; no other consumers exist; all three apps built locally OK.
